name: KIWIX
title: Information Library
desc: Offline Wikipedia, medical references, repair guides and ebooks served from ZIM archives.
note: Place .zim archives in the data folder below before deploying.

name: KOLIBRI
title: Education Platform
desc: Offline courses and lessons with progress tracking for multiple learners.
note: Import channels (Khan Academy and others) from inside Kolibri while you have a link.

name: CALIBRE-WEB
title: E-book Library
desc: Browse, read and download a shelf of e-books from any device on the network.
note: Put a Calibre library in the books folder. Default login is admin / admin123: change it.

name: DOKUWIKI
title: Group Wiki
desc: A wiki stored as plain text files, for the group's own procedures, plans and local knowledge.

name: OLLAMA
title: Local Model Server
desc: Runs language models on this machine. Powers the Advisor module with no outside link.
note: After deploying, pull a model once: docker exec shelter-ollama ollama pull llama3.2:3b

name: OPEN WEBUI
title: Full Chat Workspace
desc: A complete chat interface for local models, with document upload, chat history and multiple users.
note: Expects Ollama on this machine at port 11434. The first account created becomes the administrator.

name: CYBERCHEF
title: Data Tools
desc: Encoding, encryption, hashing and data analysis in the browser.

name: IT-TOOLS
title: Technical Utilities
desc: Dozens of small converters and generators: units, subnets, QR codes, timestamps, passwords.

name: STIRLING PDF
title: PDF Workshop
desc: Merge, split, compress, convert and OCR PDF documents without sending them anywhere.

name: EXCALIDRAW
title: Sketch Board
desc: A whiteboard for site plans, wiring diagrams and route sketches. Drawings save as files in the browser.

name: FILE BROWSER
title: Shared Files
desc: Upload, download and organise files on this node from any browser: scans, manuals, photos, maps.
note: The first-run admin password is printed once in the container log: docker logs shelter-filebrowser

name: VAULTWARDEN
title: Password Vault
desc: A password manager server compatible with Bitwarden apps. Keeps credentials and secure notes on your own hardware.
note: The web vault only works from this machine (localhost) unless you put it behind HTTPS.

name: GITEA
title: Code and Document Archive
desc: Version-controlled storage for code, configuration and documents, with a web interface.

name: FLATNOTES
title: Shared Notes
desc: Markdown note-taking stored as plain files, for the whole group.

name: GROCY
title: Pantry and Household
desc: Detailed stock control: barcodes, best-before dates, shopping lists, chores and battery tracking.
note: Default login is admin / admin: change it.

name: MEALIE
title: Recipes and Meal Plans
desc: A recipe book and meal planner. Save recipes while you have a link and cook from them without one.

name: JELLYFIN
title: Video Library
desc: Streams your own films, training videos and recorded courses to any screen on the network.
note: Copy video files into the media folder, then add /media as a library during setup.

name: AUDIOBOOKSHELF
title: Audiobooks and Podcasts
desc: Listen to audiobooks and downloaded podcast episodes, with progress kept per listener.

name: NAVIDROME
title: Music Library
desc: Streams your own music collection. Light enough to run on very small hardware.
